summary: Unified the Agent, Skills, and Extensions settings into a single 'Agent resources' area with internal tabs (Instructions & tools, Skills, Extensions). The Instructions & tools tab now provides a shared workbench for the system prompt and AGENTS.md, with a file selector on the left and a full-height Markdown editor on the right, mirroring the skills editor. Removed the standalone Extensions section from Instructions & tools and consolidated all extension management (Gizmo/Pi installed extensions plus registries) under the Extensions tab.
decisions: Consolidated Agent, Skills, and Extensions under one sidebar destination ('Agent resources') with three local tabs instead of separate routes, while preserving existing route names for deep links.
Built a shared 'instructions workbench' pattern: left-side file selector and full-height Markdown editor, so System Prompt and AGENTS.md editing use the same large-editor experience as Skills.
Moved all extension enable/disable and registry management into the Extensions tab so there is exactly one place to manage extensions, removing the extensions block from the Instructions & tools tab.
